role: The frustum test data holder: six normalized clip planes plus the projection, modelview and combined matrices, and isBoxInFrustum, the 4-corner-per-plane AABB test RenderGlobal and RenderManager cull with.
scope_reason: Culling decides what the compared frame draws; the native renderer reproduces the decision for sections.

members.name: frustum
members.note: the native pipeline never materializes the six planes; it tests the box's eight corners through the projection and modelview directly, which decides the same in/out question

members.name: projectionMatrix
members.note: the frame's proj matrix (raster.c struct frame f->proj)

members.name: clippingMatrix
members.note: proj*modelview product; implicit in the native per-corner evaluation

members.name: isBoxInFrustum
members.note: live_culled tests all 8 box corners against all 6 clip planes with a 1e-3 rounding margin; the Java tests 4 corners per plane without a margin, so exactly-on-plane boxes can differ, which the per-triangle GL clip (clip_triangle) then resolves correctly for anything drawn

notes: Used by RenderGlobal.clipRenderersByFrustum (sections) and RenderManager's entity cull. The section-level counterpart is proven by the terrain scenes; an entity-level frustum cull is not reproduced (raster_mobs uses the render-distance range check only). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): GL plumbing: GL is the numerical oracle, not emitted (SPEC); atlases and meshes are consumed as data. Formerly listed as missing: The stored plane arrays and the exact 4-corner formulation: the native test evaluates corners in clip space with a rounding margin instead of normalized planes; identical decisions except for boxes exactly on a plane.
